Ajustar a experiência não significa remo: Adjusting the experience does not mean removing accessibility barriers.
Esta ferramenta permite personalizar a a: This tool lets you personalize how content is presented. That may be useful, but it does not mean a site has become accessible. Before implementing features like these, consider a few questions.
Antes de implementar qualquer tipo de fe: Before implementing any adjustment tool, ask yourself the following questions
1. Se os problemas estão no código e no: 1. If the problems are in the code and content, why try to solve them by changing their appearance?
Imagens sem descrição, botões sem nomes: Images without descriptions, buttons without accessible names, unlabeled forms, and components that cannot be operated with a keyboard are examples of barriers that do not disappear when you enlarge text, change colors, or highlight elements.
2. Estamos oferecendo novas possibilidad: 2. Are we offering new possibilities or trying to compensate for problems that should have been fixed?
Preferências podem melhorar a experiênci: Preferences can improve the experience for some people. But they should not justify leaving known barriers in place. Before adding features, make sure the existing functionality can be used.
3. Se as pessoas já possuem suas própria: 3. If people already have their own preferences and assistive technologies, are we respecting those choices?
Navegadores, sistemas operacionais e tec: Browsers, operating systems, and assistive technologies already offer many personalization features. An additional tool should respect those settings, offer choices, and avoid interfering with people's experience.
4. Reflita: Por que os sites das grandes: 4. Consider: Why do the websites of major technology companies such as Apple, Google, and Microsoft not use this kind of feature, yet remain fully accessible?
A argumentação de quem oferece uma ferra: The sales pitch for overlay tools is persuasive, but these tools are not important for removing accessibility barriers and generally only slow your site down. If you still consider features like these relevant, look for ways to implement them without spending money on them. Prefer investing your budget in training the teams involved in developing your websites and apps.
5. Lembre-se: Quantidade de funcionalida: 5. Remember: The number of features is NOT a measure of accessibility
Não importa quantos recursos são ofereci: It does not matter how many features are offered when most of them are already available to the people who need them. Some examples:
Pessoas daltônicas adaptam as cores do p: People with color vision deficiencies adjust colors in their own operating systems, so providing additional features for this is not relevant.
Há diferentes formas de se ampliar conte: There are different ways to enlarge content, through a keyboard or browser settings. People who need magnification already do this naturally.
Todos os sistemas operacionais oferecem: All operating systems offer options to enlarge mouse pointers or change their colors, so a specific feature for this is unnecessary.
Ferramentas de ajustes são complementare: Adjustment tools are complementary. Do not use them as a solution to accessibility problems.
Para compreender melhor por que ferramen: To better understand why overlay tools do not replace accessibility work,
Não acredite em ferramentas milagrosas d: Do not believe in miracle accessibility tools

Nunca é demais lembrar que estes recurso: It is worth repeating that these features duplicate functions that already exist. That said, these are the available features and functions:
Original, preto sobre branco, branco sob: Original, black on white, white on black, yellow on black, and sepia.
Contornos e altura mínima em campos e bo: Outlines and a minimum height for fields and buttons; underlining and bold text for links.
Original, fonte do sistema, com serifa,: Original, system font, serif, Arial, Atkinson Hyperlegible, Lexend, Open Sans, and Verdana.
Ativação independente da fonte escolhida: Can be enabled independently of the selected font.
Pausa animações compatíveis e vídeos HTM: Pauses supported animations and HTML videos, and disables transitions.
Silencia elementos de áudio e vídeo HTML: Mutes HTML audio and video elements that the tool can access.
movimentação por arraste, setas do tecla: move the panel by dragging, using arrow keys, or using direction buttons, with position information for screen readers.

Esta declaração abrange este site e o pa: This statement covers this website and the preferences panel available here. Installing the panel on another site does not make that site accessible or transfer the practices described on this page to it.
Encontrou algum problema aqui?: Have you encountered a problem here?

Para ajudar a entender a barreira, infor: To help us understand the barrier, please include the following, if possible:
The page and control you were using.
What you tried to do and what happened.
O navegador, o dispositivo e a tecnologi: The browser, device, and assistive technology you used.
Quais preferências estavam ativas quando: Which preferences were active when the problem occurred.
Não é necessário conhecer termos técnico: You do not need to know technical terms to contact us. If the problem occurred on another website using the tool, please include that site's address too.
O cuidado começa na estrutura das página: Care begins with the structure of the pages and interaction with each control. Reading adjustments are an additional part of the experience.
O que fizemos no site e nesta ferramenta: What have we done on the website and in this tool?
organizamos o conteúdo com títulos, regi: we organize content using headings, navigation regions, and main content, plus a link to skip directly to the content.
usamos botões, caixas de seleção, listas: we use native buttons, checkboxes, option lists, and expandable groups, with associated labels and visible focus indicators.
ao abrir, o foco vai para o título. Fech: when it opens, focus moves to its heading. Closing it or pressing Escape returns focus to the trigger when it remains available. Moving focus outside closes the panel without pulling focus back.
grupos com ajustes diferentes do padrão: groups with nondefault settings display the text “Configured”, even when collapsed. The information does not rely on color alone.
a camada flutuante oferece botões de dir: the floating panel provides direction buttons and arrow-key movement on the “Move panel” button. We include instructions, an approximate position description, and status messages about movement and screen boundaries.
as marcas têm textos alternativos. As il: logos have alternative text. Decorative illustrations do not add repetitive descriptions. Links that open a new tab and shortcuts within the page include additional information for screen readers.
usamos tamanhos de texto relativos, layo: we use relative text sizes, layouts that rearrange on small screens, and internal panel scrolling to reach its controls.
a rolagem suave das âncoras respeita a p: smooth scrolling for anchor links respects the system's reduced-motion preference. The panel also offers pausing for supported animations and videos, and muting for HTML audio and video.
é possível alterar cada preferência ou u: each preference can be changed individually or reset using “Restore defaults”. Content adjustments are saved in the browser, per site; the tool continues to work when storage is unavailable.
Realizamos verificações de navegação por: We check keyboard navigation, panel opening and closing, applying and restoring preferences, movement messages, and presentation on small screens.
A fala das mensagens de movimento foram: Spoken movement messages were validated using the VoiceOver screen reader.
A existência de uma mensagem no código n: Having a message in the code does not, by itself, guarantee the same experience across all browser and assistive technology combinations. Specific testing is important.
Relatos de uso nos ajudam a orientar cor: Reports from people using the site help guide our fixes. This statement describes the current implementation and its limitations.
A ferramenta não cria descrições de imag: The tool does not create image descriptions, fix forms, or reorganize page semantics. Font, color, spacing, and zoom adjustments depend on the site's HTML and CSS and may require manual review. Magnification can cause horizontal scrolling.
Silenciar e pausar não controla todos os: Muting and pausing do not control every format: embedded third-party players, Web Audio, GIFs, canvas, and some scripted movement may remain active. The tool's zoom also does not replace native browser zoom.
Observar, testar e melhorar faz parte do: Observing, testing, and improving are part of the work.
Priorize a capacitação das equipes, a pa: Prioritize team training, participation by people with disabilities, and removing barriers within the project itself. To understand the limits of overlay tools' promises, visit
